question: What was the primary occupation of the Indian population on the eve of independence? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Trade
Industry
Services
Agriculture
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Agriculture

Explanation:
At the time of independence in 1947, the Indian economy was predominantly agrarian. About 85% of the population lived in villages and most of them were dependent on agriculture. The agricultural sector contributed over 50% to the Gross Domestic Product. Industrialization was very limited and the service sector was in its nascent stage. Hence, agriculture was the primary source of livelihood.

☛ What was agriculture's share in India's GDP in 1947? → Over 50%
☛ When did the Green Revolution start in India? → In the 1960s
☛ What type of economy was pre-independence India? → Agrarian
☛ When was the first Agricultural Commission established in India? → In 1926
question_hi: स्वतंत्रता की पूर्व संध्या पर भारतीय जनसंख्या का प्राथमिक व्यवसाय क्या था? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)
options_hi: व्यापार
उद्योग
सेवाएँ
कृषि
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है कृषि

Explanation:
स्वतंत्रता प्राप्ति के समय 1947 में भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था मुख्यतः कृषि प्रधान थी। लगभग 85% जनसंख्या गाँवों में निवास करती थी और उनमें से अधिकांश कृषि पर निर्भर थे। कृषि क्षेत्र का सकल घरेलू उत्पाद में योगदान लगभग 50% से अधिक था। औद्योगीकरण बहुत सीमित था और सेवा क्षेत्र प्रारंभिक अवस्था में था। इस कारण कृषि प्रमुख आजीविका का स्रोत थी।

question: Which of the following countries shares an international boundary with the Indian State of Assam? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: China (Tibet)
Bangladesh
Myanmar
Nepal
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Bangladesh

Explanation:
The state of Assam is located in the northeastern part of India and shares international borders with two countries: Bhutan and Bangladesh. Among the given options, only Bangladesh shares a boundary with Assam. China (Tibet) borders Arunachal Pradesh and Sikkim, Myanmar borders Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Manipur and Mizoram, and Nepal borders Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal and Sikkim. Hence, the correct answer is Bangladesh.

question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा देश भारत के असम राज्य के साथ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सीमा साझा करता है? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)
options_hi: चीन (तिब्बत)
बांग्लादेश
म्यांमार
नेपाल
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है बांग्लादेश

Explanation:
असम राज्य भारत के पूर्वोत्तर भाग में स्थित है और इसकी अंतर्राष्ट्रीय सीमाएँ दो देशों से लगती हैं: भूटान और बांग्लादेश। विकल्पों में दिए गए देशों में से केवल बांग्लादेश असम के साथ सीमा साझा करता है। चीन (तिब्बत) अरुणाचल प्रदेश और सिक्किम से लगता है, म्यांमार अरुणाचल प्रदेश, नागालैंड, मणिपुर और मिजोरम से लगता है, और नेपाल उत्तराखंड, उत्तर प्रदेश, बिहार, पश्चिम बंगाल और सिक्किम से लगता है। अतः सही उत्तर बांग्लादेश है।

question: The Mundra Port, India’s largest private port, is located in: (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)

question_hi: भारत का सबसे बड़ा निजी बंदरगाह, मुंद्रा बंदरगाह, कहाँ स्थित है? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)

महाराष्ट्र
गुजरात
तमिलनाडु
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है गुजरात

Explanation:
मुंद्रा बंदरगाह भारत का सबसे बड़ा निजी बंदरगाह है, जो गुजरात के कच्छ जिले में स्थित है। यह अदानी समूह द्वारा संचालित है और इसका प्रबंधन अदानी पोर्ट्स एंड स्पेशल इकोनॉमिक ज़ोन लिमिटेड (APSEZ) करता है। यह बंदरगाह व्यापार और कार्गो हैंडलिंग के लिए अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण है। मुंद्रा बंदरगाह का निर्माण 1990 के दशक में शुरू हुआ और यह अब देश के प्रमुख बंदरगाहों में से एक है। इसकी सामरिक स्थिति के कारण यह अंतरराष्ट्रीय व्यापार मार्गों से जुड़ा है।

question: The western coastal plains extend from __________ coastal region in the north to _____________ in the south. (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Konkan; Malabar
Gujarat; Kerala
Maharashtra; Tamil Nadu
Kathiawar; Karnataka
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Gujarat; Kerala

Explanation:
The western coastal plains are located along the west coast of India bordering the Arabian Sea. They extend from the coastal region of Gujarat in the north to Kerala in the south. These plains are divided into three sections: the northern part called the Gujarat coast, the central part called the Konkan coast (Maharashtra and Goa), and the southern part called the Malabar coast (Kerala and part of Karnataka). Konkan and Malabar are subdivisions of the western coastal plains, not the northern and southern boundaries. The Gujarat coast includes the Kutch and Kathiawar regions, while the Kerala coast is known for its backwaters and lagoons.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Northern limit of western coastal plains → Gujarat coast
☛ Southern limit of western coastal plains → Kerala coast
☛ Between which states is Konkan coast located? → Maharashtra and Goa
☛ In which state is Malabar coast located? → Kerala and Karnataka
☛ Which mountain range lies to the east of the western coastal plains? → Western Ghats
question_hi: पश्चिमी तटीय मैदान उत्तर में __________ तटीय क्षेत्र से दक्षिण में _____________ तक विस्तृत हैं। (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)

गुजरात; केरल
महाराष्ट्र; तमिलनाडु
काठियावाड़; कर्नाटक
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है गुजरात; केरल

Explanation:
पश्चिमी तटीय मैदान भारत के पश्चिमी तट पर अरब सागर के किनारे स्थित हैं। ये उत्तर में गुजरात के तटीय क्षेत्र से शुरू होकर दक्षिण में केरल तक फैले हुए हैं। इन मैदानों को तीन भागों में बांटा गया है: उत्तरी भाग गुजरात तट, मध्य भाग कोंकण तट (महाराष्ट्र और गोवा), और दक्षिणी भाग मालाबार तट (केरल और कर्नाटक का हिस्सा)। कोंकण और मालाबार पश्चिमी तटीय मैदान के उपखंड हैं, न कि उत्तर-दक्षिण सीमाएं। गुजरात तट में कच्छ और काठियावाड़ क्षेत्र शामिल हैं, जबकि केरल तट पर बैकवाटर और लैगून पाए जाते हैं।

question: The Malabar Coast lies between: (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: Mangalore and Kanyakumari
Gujarat and Kanyakumari
Mumbai and Kerala
Goa and Gujarat
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Mangalore and Kanyakumari

Explanation:
The Malabar Coast is the southern part of India's western coast, stretching from Mangalore (Karnataka) to Kanyakumari (Tamil Nadu). It includes the coastal regions of Kerala and parts of Karnataka. To its north lie the Konkan Coast (Mumbai to Goa) and the Gujarat Coast. The Malabar Coast is famous for its Western Ghats, backwaters, and spice trade. Major ports include Kochi, Kozhikode, and Mangalore. Kanyakumari is the southernmost tip of India, where the Arabian Sea, Bay of Bengal, and Indian Ocean meet.

☛ Largest port on Malabar Coast → Kochi
☛ Northern limit of Malabar Coast → Mangalore
☛ Southern limit of Malabar Coast → Kanyakumari
☛ State with maximum extent of Malabar Coast → Kerala

question: The Brahmaputra river is navigable by steamers up to Dibrugarh by which of the following national waterways of India? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)
options: National Waterway 3 (NW 3)
National Waterway 1 (NW 1)
National Waterway 4 (NW 4)
National Waterway 2 (NW 2)
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is National Waterway 2 (NW 2)

Explanation:
National Waterway 2 (NW 2) is located on the Brahmaputra river, stretching 891 km from Sadiya to Dhubri. This waterway facilitates the operation of steamers up to Dibrugarh due to the adequate depth and width of the Brahmaputra. NW 1 is on the Ganga river from Haldia to Allahabad, NW 3 is on the west coast from Kollam to Kottapuram, and NW 4 is on the Krishna and Godavari rivers. Therefore, the navigability of the Brahmaputra up to Dibrugarh is provided by NW 2.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ On which river is National Waterway 2 located? → Brahmaputra river
☛ What is the total length of NW 2? → 891 km
☛ Between which points does NW 2 lie? → Sadiya to Dhubri
☛ Which national waterway allows steamers up to Dibrugarh? → NW 2
☛ Which is the longest national waterway in India? → NW 1 (Ganga river)
question_hi: भारत के निम्नलिखित में से किस राष्ट्रीय जलमार्ग द्वारा ब्रह्मपुत्र नदी डिब्रूगढ़ तक स्टीमरों द्वारा नौगम्य है? (RPF Constable 2024 (03/03/2025) Shift 3)

question: The Kavaratti Island is a part of which Union Territory/Territories of India? (RPF Constable 2024 (04/03/2025) Shift 1)
options: Dadra and Nagar Haveli & Daman and Diu
Puducherry
Lakshadweep
Andaman and Nicobar Islands
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Lakshadweep

Explanation:
Kavaratti Island is a part of the Union Territory of Lakshadweep, India. Lakshadweep is an archipelago of 36 islands in the Arabian Sea, out of which 10 are inhabited. Kavaratti serves as the capital of Lakshadweep and houses a major tourist destination. The island is known for its white sandy beaches, clear blue waters, and rich marine life. Administratively, Lakshadweep is a union territory governed by an administrator appointed by the President of India. The area of Kavaratti Island is about 4.22 sq km, and the primary language spoken here is Malayalam.

question: What is the main feature of the Bhangar region in the Northern Plains? (RPF Constable 2024 (04/03/2025) Shift 1)

question: What is the primary characteristic of the Thar Desert's soil? (RPF Constable 2024 (04/03/2025) Shift 1)

question: Which type of seeds became popular during the Green Revolution in India? (RPF Constable 2024 (04/03/2025) Shift 2)
options: High-yielding varieties (HYVs)
Organic seeds
Indigenous seeds
Traditional seeds
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is High-yielding varieties (HYVs)

Explanation:
During the Green Revolution in India (1960s-70s), High-Yielding Varieties (HYVs) of seeds were widely adopted. These seeds, particularly for wheat and rice, were developed by Norman Borlaug and included dwarf varieties like Lerma Rojo and Sonora-64 for wheat, and IR8 for rice. HYVs were designed to be used with chemical fertilizers, pesticides, and irrigation, leading to a significant increase in yield per hectare. The architect of India's Green Revolution was M.S. Swaminathan. This approach made India self-sufficient in food grains but also had environmental and social impacts. HYVs replaced traditional and indigenous seeds due to their higher productivity.

question: The Punjab Plains are primarily drained by which river system? (RPF Constable 2024 (04/03/2025) Shift 2)

Yamuna
Brahmaputra
Indus
solution:

Explanation:
The Punjab Plains are primarily drained by the Indus river system. The Indus River and its five major tributaries—Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas and Sutlej—flow through this region. The Ganga, Yamuna and Brahmaputra river systems do not drain the Punjab region; they flow through northern and eastern India instead.

question: The Season of Retreating Monsoon occurs during which of the following months in India? (RPF Constable 2024 (04/03/2025) Shift 2)

October - November
June - September
December - February
solution:

During this period, monsoon winds weaken and reverse direction, activating northeast monsoon winds. question: Which of the following is a ‘Loo’ wind affected region of India? (RPF Constable 2024 (04/03/2025) Shift 3)

solution:
